title: Five Non-Compensable Rights Floors in Market Coordination

cells.person: Cannot be waived in exchange for tier discounts or loyalty points

cells.market: 2. Continuous Contestability (Right to challenge representative mandates)
cells.person: Cannot be superseded by platform terms of service or binding arbitration

cells.market: 3. Constraint Intelligibility (Transparent representation of pooled needs)
cells.person: Cannot be obscured behind proprietary algorithmic black boxes

cells.market: 4. Telemetry Privacy (Zero behavioral tracking outside declared constraints)
cells.person: Cannot be traded for subsidized search access or personalized ads

cells.market: 5. Outside Option Parity (Do not aggregate is a protected, valid result)
cells.person: Cannot impose structural penalties on participants choosing independent alternatives
